scope: Existing native Kamoer scan evidence and primary manufacturer sources for the factory-prepared stem connection. No finished connection pressure, pull or lifetime acceptance is claimed.
interpretation: The full pump rigid-head Y maximum includes the broad skirt and is not the local rigid-casing endpoint at either tube. The native outlet sections show exposed flexible tube sufficient to place a 2.54 mm-wide factory tie in its midband. Material boundaries are visual regions, not manufactured stations. Tube bending and the retained head transverse datum limit absolute placement accuracy.

candidate_factory_tie.head_orientation: +Z into the cartridge open tube channel
candidate_factory_tie.scope: Nominal fit location based on existing observations; actual tie-head clearance, tightening, seal and retained pull require the assembled article.

stem_stock.grade: Röchling Polystone P homopolymer natural extruded PP-H, PIM590980
stem_stock.declaration_scope: Resin-basis declaration to 21 CFR177.1520; finished machining, application, migration and sensory suitability are not certified by this declaration.

machining_targets.scope: Engineering drawing requirements for this design, not a published fit/rating of the custom TPU socket. The lead lies beyond the operating seal band; no sharp burr or continuous axial/helical score crosses that band.

chemical_basis.scope: Generic selection guidance favors PP for continuously acidic flavor paths. Actual concentrate, cleaning exposure and finished stem aging remain application-specific.
